CALIBER 2026 · CASE 1 · MANUFACTURING KNOWLEDGE HUB
An engineering knowledge hub that would rather refuse than guess.
Datasheets, interlock logic, procedures and maintenance history for one unit of an LLDPE plant, in one index. Every answer carries a trust badge, the documents behind it, and the reason for its score. A question with no supportable source gets a refusal and an explanation, not a sentence.
Open the app
How it works
What it does not claim
95
documents indexed, with real document numbers, revisions and approval records
8
equipment units, each with a datasheet, GA, interlock diagram and plot plan
211
work orders joined from the maintenance workbook, 31 of them breakdowns
0
contradictions among extracted trip set points, out of 105 values extracted
The problem
Not “information is hard to find”. A plant already has the documents. What it does not have is any way to know which of them applies, whether it is current, and whether it has been approved.
The right document, the wrong revision
An engineer finds a set point in a drawing that was superseded two revisions ago. The number is right in the file and wrong for the plant. Nothing in a PDF tells you which revision you are holding.
The document that is not there
The procedure you need was never written, or lives in a drawer. A chat assistant fills the gap with a plausible sentence, and that sentence is indistinguishable from a real one.
Eleven documents per unit
Eight units, five baseline document types each, plus one-point lessons written after individual failures. Nobody holds all of it in their head, and the relevant document is rarely the one already open.
How it works
Four steps, in this order. The check for whether an answer is permitted at all happens before anything is written, not after.
01
Ingest once, from the real files
87 single-page PDFs, 8 P&ID drawings and the maintenance workbook are parsed into one SQLite index: 95 documents, 362 text chunks, 211 work orders, 105 measured parameter values.
02
Extract, and record where it came from
Trip set points are read from datasheet tables and interlock logic with their operator, value and unit kept intact. Approval status comes from the revision history and signature blocks that are actually present in each document type.
03
Retrieve, then check whether to answer
SQLite FTS5 over the indexed chunks, scoped to the equipment tag in the question where one is named. Before any answer is composed, the question is tested against what the index actually contains.
04
Score it, badge it, or refuse
Five weighted signals produce one number, the number produces TRUSTED, VERIFY or DO NOT EXECUTE, and the sources behind the answer are listed with their document number, revision and approval status.
The four baseline data types
Joined by the key the dataset itself specifies — the equipment tag, which the dataset’s own documentation calls the join key to all other documents.
Equipment datasheets
Manufacturer data and physical parameters per unit.
Read from PDF tables, not linear text. Reading these files in text order loses the pairing between a label and its value, which is the only thing that makes them usable.
Cause & effect / interlock logic
Which condition trips which protective function.
The trip set points live here. 31 interlock parameters are extracted as structured values with their operators, not as prose.
Operating procedures (GA, OPL, plot plan)
How to do the work, and what was learned after it went wrong.
55 one-point lessons carry real signature blocks - reviewed and approved by named people - so a procedure can be traced to the person accountable for it.
Maintenance history
Work orders, breakdowns, downtime and cost from the workbook.
19 of 31 breakdowns already have a one-point lesson attached to them. The other 12 are the gap, and the system reports them rather than hiding them.
The trust engine
Five weighted signals, one score, three badges. The weights are properties of document provenance, not of a model’s confidence, because no model is involved in producing them.
Weights
Approval
0.30
Is the source an approved, issued revision?
Revision
0.20
Does it carry a revision and an effective date?
Agreement
0.20
Do several documents state the same value?
Relevance
0.20
How well does the retrieved text match the question?
Coverage
0.10
How much of the answer comes from more than one source?
TRUSTED at 0.80 — approved, revisioned, corroborated.
VERIFY at 0.50 — usable after checking the cited document.
DO NOT EXECUTE below 0.50, or refused outright when no source supports the question.
What it refuses, and why
Refusals are the feature, not the failure mode. A hub that answers everything is fluent, not trustworthy.
What does OPL-GA-1201A-04 cover?
That one-point lesson is genuinely missing from the dataset. The system declines rather than substituting the six lessons that do exist for the same unit.
What is the shutdown procedure for ZX-9999?
No document mentions that unit, so no document can be a source.
What is the trip setpoint for ZSO-9999?
The tag is instrument-shaped but not in the index. Answering from another unit's excerpt would have been fluent and wrong.
How do I open a bank account?
Retrieval returns chunks for any text. The domain vocabulary gate stops unrelated questions before they can be answered from plant documents.
What this system does not claim
Listed here rather than in a footer, because a knowledge-hub demo that only shows its strengths is asking to be audited for the rest.
—
The dataset is labelled by its own authors as sample data. Trip set points and costs are stated to be dummy training values; the document structure, revision history and approval records are used as given.
—
No language model is called by default. Answers are assembled from indexed text and measured values, so nothing is generated and nothing can be hallucinated - but nothing is paraphrased either, and procedural steps are quoted rather than restated.
—
Zero contradictions means the extracted values agree with each other. It does not mean the plant is safe, and it does not mean every parameter in the documents was extracted.
—
The dataset is not committed to this repository. It is fetched with one command, because its licence does not permit redistribution.
The demo path
Nine pages. A judge can see the whole claim in about four minutes: ask a question, check its sources, then check whether those sources agree.
Ask
The product. A question, a badge, the documents behind it, and the arithmetic behind the score.
Equipment
One unit at a time: every document, its full work-order history in date order, and the failures with a linked lesson.
Documents
The register. Document number, revision, effective date, and the approval marker found in the file.
Graph
How the documents join. 8 units, 8 interlock diagrams, 8 datasheets, 8 plot plans, 55 lessons, 31 breakdowns.
Verification
Whether the documents agree. Extraction inventory beside the conflict count, because zero conflicts alone means nothing.
Maintenance
211 work orders and 31 breakdowns, with downtime and cost, and lesson coverage per unit.
Overview
What this instance currently holds, and what it does not claim.
Audit
The weight table printed in full, so any score can be recomputed by hand, plus every question asked.
Dataset
Provenance, the known gaps in the file set, and the LLM policy.
Open the app
Built with
Next.js 15
React 19
TypeScript
Tailwind CSS
FastAPI
SQLite
SQLite FTS5
pdfplumber
openpyxl
Retrieval is SQLite FTS5 rather than a hosted vector database, so the whole system runs on one machine with no API key and no external service. The dataset is fetched with python -m plant.fetch_dataset and is not committed, because its licence does not permit redistribution.

**Vibration Trend Monitoring & Alarm Response, section procedure**
DETAILED PROCEDURE / STEPS Step Action Check / Acceptance 1 Record VT-1201 on the daily PdM route in mm/s RMS Loop isolated / under permit 2 Note alarm at 4.5 mm/s and trip at 7.1 mm/s (VSHH-1201) Reference standard traceable 3 A rise greater than 1 mm/s within a week = plan a bearing inspection As-found & as-left recorded 4 Correlate the vibration rise with TI-1201 bearing temperature Trip / control action verified 5 Escalate to reliability engineer if the 1x running-speed component dominates Return to service con
